findings.text: _exit_a_handle_already_collected is a second exit-reading path with no test: no case drives the except (ChildProcessError, OSError) branch at 5292 with a carrier whose Popen holds a returncode, so a regression that made the helper return None again — the scope of the branch's docstring is identical to the branch that does nothing — would leave every assertion in tests/test_a_killed_worker_resumes_to_completion.py green; only the handle-retention half of the repair is guarded.

the arm table (and the manifest's checkpoint line) attribute the head and base node-test runs to an all_debug job, but neither cited log carries a Slurm marker: scoped-gate-1795073641904856472.log and base-arm.log open with '# revision:' / '# host:' / '# tree:' / '# command:' only, so the done_when's venue clause and its SLURM_JOB_ID-unset half are asserted in prose rather than shown by the artefact that is on disk.

the fragment's head-arm row cites c529224d9b while the manifest's checkpoint and tests line place the head gate at 1e946a6526; a green log exists at each revision (scoped-gate-1795072858960365093.log '1 passed in 6.76s' EXIT=0 at c529224d9b, scoped-gate-1795073641904856472.log '1 passed in 6.51s' EXIT=0 at 1e946a6526), so the substance is unaffected, but two records of one arm name different revisions and a reader cannot tell which ran where.
